queries.prompt: metroidvania with a big map to explore and tough combat
expected_titles: Ori and the Will of the Wisps

queries.prompt: grand strategy where I run a galactic empire
queries.note: Single right answer. Tests that 'galactic' beats generic strategy titles.

queries.prompt: roguelike deckbuilder where each run I build a new deck
queries.note: The two Deckbuilder-genre games.

queries.prompt: sci-fi survival horror aboard a derelict space station
queries.note: Horror games set in space or deep-sea stations; Outlast and Amnesia are horror but not sci-fi.

queries.prompt: something calm and low stress to unwind with after a long day
queries.note: Mood only, no genre words. Cozy and relaxing tags with no fail pressure.

queries.prompt: an emotional story that will probably make me cry
queries.note: Emotional or story-rich narrative games; tests that 'cry' maps to the emotional tag.

queries.prompt: genuinely scary, I want to feel tense the whole time
queries.note: Horror tagged tense. Left 4 Dead (horror-lite) should not count.

queries.prompt: silly chaotic fun for a party with friends on the couch
queries.note: Party and comedy games played in a group.

queries.prompt: brutally hard but rewarding when I finally beat it
queries.note: Difficult tag across genres, so the right answers span Souls games and precision platformers.

queries.prompt: like Stardew Valley but with more crafting and building
queries.note: Cozy life sims with crafting. The reference game itself is not a good answer.

queries.prompt: something like Dark Souls but with samurai and ninjas
queries.note: Both are hard Japanese-setting action games. Dark Souls III is the reference, not an answer.

queries.prompt: I finished Hades, what other fast action roguelikes should I try
queries.note: Fast-paced action roguelikes. Slay the Spire and Balatro are roguelikes but not action.

queries.prompt: Factorio but in 3D and a bit less overwhelming
queries.note: Single right answer: the 3D factory builder.

queries.prompt: short story game like Firewatch where you mostly walk and explore
queries.note: Walking-sim and narrative adventure games.

queries.prompt: cozy farming game I can play on Xbox
queries.note: Farming sims sold on the Xbox store. Dinkum is a farming sim but has no Xbox release.

queries.prompt: co-op shooter on Steam where my friends and I fight off hordes
queries.note: Co-op shooters against waves of enemies, all on Steam.

queries.prompt: action roguelike on the Epic Games Store
queries.note: Both Hades games launched on the Epic store. The local catalogue is Steam-only, so this one only scores on the hosted schema.

queries.prompt: story-heavy RPG on Xbox where my choices change the ending
queries.note: Choice-driven RPGs with an Xbox release.

queries.prompt: survive on a remote island and build a base with friends, on Steam
queries.note: Platform plus genre filter together. Co-op survival with base building.
